description:
NovaGlitch is a team from Pakistan taking part in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 through the Islamabad local event. We love space, and we joined to work with real NASA data and help solve a space problem.

We chose "Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map" and built the Jezero Traverse Map, an interactive web map of Jezero Crater that uses machine learning and route planning to find safe walking routes for astronauts on Mars.
